Operation executed is set before the external call; the same operation cannot replay. Permissionless execution of a different matured authorized operation is intentional. Event emission does not grant authority.

Timestamp is intentionally used to enforce the constitutional multi-day delay floor with checked uint64 overflow; it does not provide randomness or instant transaction ordering authority. A block producer cannot eliminate a seven-day floor. Cancellation does not use block time; that report follows the Operation struct and its closed-state checks.
